title: helenium angustifolium
intro: Helenium angustifolium, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Sneezeweed, is a perennial plant native to North America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can aid in soothing digestive issues and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Helenium angustifolium include its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-spasmodic, and expectorant, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
